question.knowledge_point: Plotting the Product of a Matrix and an Eigenvector Given its Corresponding Eigenvalue
question.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14095012/assets/539b08ea12f9af52defd826c0b63c194f36b6de408770c1bc1975bd6ca84724f.png)

The vector $u$ is an eigenvector of a $2\times 2$ matrix $B$ corresponding to the eigenvalue $-\frac{1}{2}.$ Find the vector $Bu.$
question.worked_solution:
The eigenvector $u=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -4\end{aligned}]$ corresponds to the eigenvalue $\lambda =-\frac{1}{2}.$ So, 

$$
\begin{aligned}Bu & =-\frac{1}{2}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have the following picture:
